validation.revision: V2 canonical exact Chaos Beast route
limits: Exact directEnemy source chaosBeast, CEL enChaosBeast(Clone), motion renderer enChaosBeast and source renderer 121008 only. This archive grants no inheritance to another source or renderer topology.

The native pass preserves one complete 120-frame capture with cidle_ghost, attackProf_ghost and return to idle. Its sampled native attack reduces hero HP from 963 to 945 with recorded damage 18 and Damaged.

The ordinary zero-focus player action records immediate native damage 5 and new enemy HP 53 from 58, with damageSmall_ghost and idle recovery. A later Ready-state poll sees 45 HP after additional turns; its intervening 8-point loss is not attributed to the captured action.
The attack capture contains two later native enemy attacks that each record 18 hero damage. These extra turns prove repeated source motion but are not representative encounter balance.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reduces the later 45 HP state to 0 with recorded damage 1000 and Death. It is fixture death evidence, not ordinary lethal gameplay.

The source has m_DoRagdoll false and zero rigidbodies. death_ghost begins at retained frame 18, but the renderer is active and visible only through frame 19 and is inactive, disabled and not visible from frame 20 onward. This proves an animated disappearance boundary, not a fully visible death clip.

Pass and ordinary attack each retain all requested 120 frames. Death retains 94 of 120 requested frames and then terminates with renderer_destroyed. Exact identity is stable in all 334 retained frames; cleanup causality, later corpse lifetime and final disposal remain unproven.
Strict Ready succeeds at dungeon level 0, room 2, with one active Ready button. No Collect action is submitted and this archive makes no Collect claim.

Thirty selected original PNGs are reviewed. Native aura, impact effects, foreground hero overlap, combat UI and camera movement limit fine inspection in stated frames; the remaining 304 capture PNGs are preserved by hash but were not individually reviewed.
The profile preserves native CEL scale 1.5. Both Standard materials use authored slot textures with emission disabled, zero emission color and no emission map.

This isolated dungeon trial does not establish portrait pixels, other cameras, other resolutions, collision, all-angle culling, every Chaos Beast animation, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign progression or finished-art acceptance.
